name: what-can-you-do
description: Hand-written for design/22 #1 and #2's quick reply, so a keyless panel answers it. No figures, so it reads true in any state.

content.text: Tell me your budget and the lots you like, and I’ll suggest a plan. Once you press Start bidding, I bid for you within the rules on the card. You can pause me or change the plan anytime, and you approve any PayPal hold yourself.
